title: The Hungry Winter
text: The snow came early and stayed. The granaries of the lower town are scraped bare, and the poor queue at every House's kitchen door.

temptation.label: Sell your surplus to the speculators instead.
temptation.text: The grain merchants pay well, and ask no questions about who goes without.

triumph.text: No one starves. The common folk remember whose wagons came.

holds.text: A hard winter, but the city holds.

falters.text: The old and the very young die in the night shelters.

calamity.text: Famine. The recruit halls empty as the hungry flee, and the Houses are cursed in the streets.
